related.title: Kubernetes Probes：啟動、就緒與存活的分工
related.titleEn: Kubernetes Probes: startup, readiness and liveness roles
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 rollout.csv、卡住情境與可回復條件。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver rollout.csv, a stalled scenario and rollback conditions.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 畫出每次探測時間與結果；說明300與15是配置預算，不是從任意故障瞬間起精確的重啟延遲。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Plot probe times and outcomes;300 and15 are configuration budgets, not exact restart latencies measured from an arbitrary fault onset. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 floor(7*0.25) = 1 pods；對照 ceil(7*0.25) = 2 pods。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐輪列old/new/ready/terminating；基準可用下界6、非terminating期望總量上界9，失敗探針時不能提前回收所有舊Pod。

基準 30*10 = 300 s；對照 3*5 = 15 s。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
畫出每次探測時間與結果；說明300與15是配置預算，不是從任意故障瞬間起精確的重啟延遲。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline floor(7*0.25) = 1 pods; comparison ceil(7*0.25) = 2 pods. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Tabulate old,new,ready,terminating each round; nominal availability floor6 and nonterminating desired total cap9 do not justify deleting old Pods before readiness.

Baseline 30*10 = 300 s; comparison 3*5 = 15 s. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Plot probe times and outcomes;300 and15 are configuration budgets, not exact restart latencies measured from an arbitrary fault onset.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Google SRE: request-based SLOs and error budgets

A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 使用整數分數1/1000交叉核對預算100；本窗超支20，短窗burn rate2。不得將重試次數混入使用者請求分母。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Cross-check budget100 using exact fraction1/1000;the main window overspends by20 and short-window burn rate is2. Do not mix retries into the user-request denominator. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 floor(7*0.25) = 1 pods；對照 ceil(7*0.25) = 2 pods。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐輪列old/new/ready/terminating；基準可用下界6、非terminating期望總量上界9，失敗探針時不能提前回收所有舊Pod。

基準 100000*(1-0.999) = 100.00000000000009 events；對照 (40/20000)/(1-0.999) = 1.9999999999999982 burn-rate。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
使用整數分數1/1000交叉核對預算100；本窗超支20，短窗burn rate2。不得將重試次數混入使用者請求分母。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Baseline floor(7*0.25) = 1 pods; comparison ceil(7*0.25) = 2 pods. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Tabulate old,new,ready,terminating each round; nominal availability floor6 and nonterminating desired total cap9 do not justify deleting old Pods before readiness.

Baseline 100000*(1-0.999) = 100.00000000000009 events; comparison (40/20000)/(1-0.999) = 1.9999999999999982 burn-rate. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
